comment: Seed for scripts/workstream-lock.mjs — the CLI-first task DAG for design v0.8, specified in docs/confit-v0.8-task-dag.md. `phase` is P0 for foundation tasks, otherwise the owning lane (K kernel, M memory, L llm, X cli, S data, N nudge, G guards, U ui). Ids do not collide with the v0.3-era seed in confit-tasks.seed.json, so both can coexist while the old lanes are retired. Read the task spec in the DAG doc before claiming — the title is a label, not the spec.

P0.1.title: Repo bootstrap, CLI-shaped: Node 20 + TS strict + vitest + tsx, npm scripts, no UI deps yet

P0.2.title: Contracts freeze v0.8: types (Read = exactly six fields), flags, module interfaces, working fixture stubs
P0.2.note: After this merges src/contracts/** is integrator-only. Read is six fields — no createdAt, no received_at (DAG doc §3).

P0.3.title: Runtime config, degrade flags (extraction/narrator/pool/demoMode), logger that records every degrade transition

P0.4.title: Relay service: six routes, write token, exact-schema validation on POST /reads, server-assigned received_at, oldest_unverified_age in /stats
P0.4.note: received_at and any ingest handle are server-side metadata, never part of the read body — a body carrying them must 400.

P0.5.title: Gate zero runner (confit gate0): N=12, two re-ingest rounds, pass = all 12 retrievable, plus DELETE + verify-gone; record to docs/gate0-results.md
P0.5.note: BLOCKS BUILD DAY (design v0.8 §11, D-3). Run the moment M1 merges. If it fails, stop and escalate — the sole-store decision [E9] reopens and this DAG needs re-cutting.

K1.title: Read validator + mintReadId: closed six-field schema, enum checks, weight in [0,1]; export READ_KEYS as the single source of truth

K2.title: Off-limits matcher: isBlocked(text, topics), case/accent-insensitive, deliberately conservative
K2.note: This is the gate that stops a flagged confession being ingested anywhere ([E24]). A false negative is a duty-of-care failure; a false positive is an annoyance. Tune accordingly.

K3.title: Rotation: appetite curve, half-life fit from >=3 observations else seeded median, suppressions returning reason keys not prose
K3.note: Formula is plan v1.0 §3.5 verbatim — copy it, don't reinvent it.

K4.title: Ask scoring: plan v1.0 §3.4 verbatim, all tunable constants in constants.ts incl. KFLOOR=5, stable documented tie-break

K5.title: Copy linter: banned-lexicon scan (quantity, weight, calories, progress, streaks, scores, totals) with lexicon as data in its own file

K6.title: Cohort counting: census + matched at KFLOOR, deduped on read_id before counting; sub-floor cohorts returned as cohortMiss, never citable
K6.note: The motivating test ([E20]): four reads plus a duplicate must NOT satisfy k>=5; five identical-but-distinct reads must.

M1.title: MemoryClient over XTrace: ingest/search/remove, user_id required (not optional), explicit episode-slot reservation, pollable ingest handle
M1.note: Resolves D-2 — confirm real endpoint paths against the live API and record them in src/memory/README.md. Omitting user_id searches app-wide, so make it a required parameter.

M2.title: PoolStore: writeRead to confit:pool with read_id in content; readsForDriver implements the per-driver counting query with k above the largest seeded cohort
M2.note: Counting query and induction query are separate methods ([E22]) — induction may stay top-k, counting may not.

M3.title: UserStore: writeProse ingests raw prose unmodified, usual() and mealLog() read the personal tier; warn when unconfirmed prose is dropped
M3.note: Do not pre-clean or pre-structure the prose ([E11], §14). The prose has no relay copy by design, so its retry dies with the process — that asymmetry is intended.

M4.title: Relay client: typed six routes, parseRead before sending, bounded backoff on 5xx only

M5.title: Approval write path: isBlocked -> mint read_id -> parseRead -> three writes (user prose, pool read, relay); blocked writes nothing anywhere
M5.note: The §9 fix ([E24]) lives here: a flagged confession must not reach the prose tier either. Relay write must succeed for a read to count as pooled; a failed pool write is recoverable because the relay is the re-ingest source.

M6.title: PoolView: pool union relay for a driver, deduped on read_id; under pool=relay-only serve seeded induction set + relay and mark degraded

M7.title: Settle-sweeper: verify each stale relay entry, drop if retrievable, re-ingest from the entry's own six fields if not; verified-drop only, never TTL
M7.note: Confirm D-1 (how verification is keyed — recommended: opaque ingest_job_id as relay metadata) with the integrator before claiming. The never-drop-unverified test is the point of this task.

M8.title: Deletion by read_id across pool scope, user scope and relay, with a per-target report
M8.note: Front-end copy is 'deleted from Confit' — never imply cryptographic enforcement (design v0.8 §7).

L1.title: Template narrator + copy catalog keyed by reason key: reason, rotation, usual and cohort-miss lines, all linter-clean
L1.note: Lands before the live narrator — it is both the narrator=template degrade path and the fixture the whole suite narrates with.

L2.title: Chip preview on claude-haiku-4-5: structured output for the five chips, off-limits check before and after, one retry then extraction=seeded
L2.note: UI-only by design (§6) — nothing downstream may depend on this being correct, only on it being schema-valid. A blocked topic must make zero model calls.

L3.title: Live narrator on claude-sonnet-5: facts-only prompt, choose-from-corpus contract, linter gate -> one regenerate -> template fallback
L3.note: The prompt must contain no confession prose and must never cite a cohort below KFLOOR.

X1.title: CLI skeleton: subcommand dispatch, --profile/--json/--yes/--help, documented exit codes, rendering separated from logic
X1.note: No business logic in this lane. Commands return plain objects; render.ts prints them.

X2.title: confit confess: chips preview -> confirm -> writeRead, prints read_id and per-target status; consent copy states both halves
X2.note: Stub-first, but NOT claimable in wave 1: mock-start skips every dependency check, so this shows ready before contracts exist. Claim only once P0.2 has merged — you build against its fixture stubs. The [E27] consent sentence is asserted in a test so it cannot be dropped silently.

X3.title: confit ask: assemble and print the card — pick, reason line, cohort citation or cohort-miss, rotation/usual lines, runners-up, full score map under --json
X3.note: Stub-first, but NOT claimable in wave 1: mock-start skips every dependency check, so this shows ready before contracts exist. Claim only once P0.2 has merged — build against its stub engine/narrator/cohorts. This is the integration point. Never print a confession; never cite a cohort below KFLOOR.

X4.title: confit sweep: --once and --watch over the settle-sweeper, printing verified/re-ingested/retained and oldest_unverified_age
X4.note: This is the operator-run sweeper of [E21] — the thing that must work when the author's session is gone.

X5.title: confit forget <read_id>: per-target deletion results in the 'deleted from Confit' register

X6.title: confit pass: census with seed-manifest cross-check, seed, reset, flags --set, neartie, nudge --arm
X6.note: The census cross-check is the [E22] guard working — a counting k sized for the seed but not seed-plus-live reads must fail here, not on stage.

S1.title: Corpus: 40 hand-picked places against the Place schema with signature dishes and spice levels, plus a validator script

S2.title: Seed generator: 220 reads, every demo driver k in [5,9] across distinct places, near-tie tuned, deterministic from a fixed PRNG seed; emits manifest.json
S2.note: Near-tie target: score(top1)-score(top3) <= 0.04 and a judge read (weight >= 0.7) shifts >= 0.05. No unseeded Math.random anywhere.

S3.title: Seed loader: push generated reads to the pool scope and relay idempotently keyed on read_id, reporting any that did not land
S3.note: Seeding must run hours ahead of a demo because induction operates over the pool, not over one new read (design v0.8 §11).

N1.title: Nudge rules: opt-in default off, at most once per calendar day, permanent silence in one call, arm() for demo control; pure over injected now
N1.note: No timers in this module. Copy comes from L1's catalog, never a model.

G1.title: Pool-write schema guard: every pool/relay-bound body must be exactly READ_KEYS, closed and enum-checked; active in production code, not just tests
G1.note: [E25] replaced 'detect narrative text' with reject-by-construction because CI cannot recognise narrative. Prove the guard is active by bypassing writeRead in a test.

G2.title: Off-limits propagation test: a flagged topic yields zero new records in BOTH tiers — no pool read, no relay entry, no user-scope prose
G2.note: v0.7's version checked only the pool, which is exactly how the §9 violation survived a review cycle. Verify the test goes red when either block is removed.

G3.title: Copy-linter regression: every template in the catalog and every narrator fixture through the linter, one case per banned lexicon entry

G4.title: Near-tie invariant against the actual seed file, plus the cohort-count cross-check against the S2 manifest
G4.note: The demo's climax is CI-protected (plan v1.0 §3.4). Shrinking the counting k below the largest cohort must make the cross-check fail.

G5.title: CI wiring + npm run gate:cli: typecheck, full suite, then scripted seed -> confess -> ask -> sweep -> forget -> census end-to-end with no network
G5.note: Fails if docs/gate0-results.md records no gate-zero pass (D-3). This is the gate the UI lane waits on.

U1.title: Vite + React shell: add UI deps, routes /confess /ask /settings /pass, design tokens; imports the same core as the CLI and adds no domain logic
U1.note: UI starts only once the CLI is green. If a screen needs behaviour the CLI cannot do, that behaviour is a kernel or memory task first.

U2.title: Confess screen: textarea -> editable/strikeable chips -> Add to the pot via the same writeRead, blocked-topic state, consent copy above the button

U3.title: Ask card: pick, reason line, cohort citation, rotation/usual lines, cohort-miss variant, runners-up
U3.note: Assert that no confession text can reach the DOM on the citation and cohort-miss paths.

U4.title: Settings + nudge surface: off-limits editor, nudge opt-in, quiet banner with dismiss and silence-forever

U5.title: The Pass panel: census table, near-tie inspector, seed/reset, flag toggles, sweeper status with oldest_unverified_age
U5.note: Every action maps to an existing confit pass operation — the panel is a view over the CLI, not a second implementation.
